notes: Synchronous calls made by this service: one outbound dependency, flagd, via the OpenFeature FlagdProvider (charge.js:9 constructs it, charge.js:20 reads the boolean flag paymentServiceFailure on every charge). Host and port come from FLAGD_HOST / FLAGD_PORT in the compose environment (docker-compose.yml:440-441, values .env:129-130 flagd and 8013). The wire protocol of FlagdProvider is not stated in these files (library default, not in these files). index.js serves oteldemo.PaymentService (rpc Charge, demo.proto:177-178) and grpc.health.v1 on a grpc-js server; it makes no other client calls.
Messages published or consumed: none found in the given files (no Kafka or other broker client in package.json or the sources).
Registry/discovery/coordinator: none found in the given files; no heartbeat, failure timeout or cleanup interval stated. flagd is a feature-flag provider, not reported as a registry.

Health check: no healthcheck block for paymentservice in docker-compose.yml:423-451 and no HEALTHCHECK in src/paymentservice/Dockerfile (library default, not in these files: Compose defines none). index.js:42-44 registers a grpc-js-health-check service returning SERVING unconditionally, but no file configures a probe that calls it. Compose sets restart: unless-stopped (docker-compose.yml:435) and depends_on otelcol and flagd with condition service_started (docker-compose.yml:446-450).

Telemetry: traces via OTLPTraceExporter (opentelemetry.js:16, OTLP/gRPC package exporter-trace-otlp-grpc, package.json:24); metrics via PeriodicExportingMetricReader with OTLPMetricExporter (opentelemetry.js:25-26), no exportIntervalMillis set so the export interval is library default, not in these files; the service creates counter app.payment.transactions (charge.js:14). Logs: pino writes to stdout (logger.js:6); no OTLP log exporter is configured in opentelemetry.js, so no log export to the collector is stated in these files. Container stdout goes to the json-file logging driver (docker-compose.yml:451 logging: *logging, anchor docker-compose.yml:4-9).

Endpoint: exporter constructors take no options; the endpoint is supplied by OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT in the compose environment (docker-compose.yml:442), value from .env:32 resolving to otelcol port 4317 (.env:27-28). The collector pipelines (otelcol-config.yml:123-135) route traces to otlp/debug/spanmetrics, metrics to otlphttp/prometheus/debug, logs to opensearch/debug.

compose.candidate-postures.yml:92-102 overrides the entrypoint (node index.js without --require ./opentelemetry.js when OTEL_PLACEMENT_ENABLED is false) and sets OTEL_SDK_DISABLED / OTEL_*_EXPORTER from OTEL_CANDIDATE_PAYMENTSERVICE_* posture variables; their values are not in these files.
Container resources: memory limit 120M (docker-compose.yml:434); image node:21-alpine (Dockerfile:15); port ${PAYMENT_SERVICE_PORT}=50051 (.env:101).

replicas.note: library default, not in these files: no deploy.replicas or scale for paymentservice in docker-compose.yml:423-451 (deploy block has only resources.limits.memory) or compose.candidate-postures.yml:92-102; Compose default 1
